tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: App window background, behind the top bar and every card.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows, module tab content, the loader's card.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table row stripes, hover state of list rows, selected tab content background.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Resting card border, table rules, dividers between stacked module cards.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and the resting outline of the active tab indicator.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and card titles on surface-page and surface (15.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Card description lines, table captions, helper text on surface-page and surface (5.5:1).

tokens.name: ink-on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-700 and brand-600 fills (12.1:1 on brand-700, 5.3:1 on brand-600).

tokens.name: brand-700
tokens.usage: High-emphasis fills only — the processing-loader label chip, the active nav pill, pressed state of brand-600; no longer a full-width header bar (see Reformulação de layout).

tokens.name: brand-600
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, active tab pill, links, focus ring, module-card icon glyph, loader bars (5.3:1 with ink-on-brand).

tokens.name: brand-500
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of brand-600 fills; hover border color of a module card.

tokens.name: brand-100
tokens.usage: Selected list row / active tab pill background, module-card icon-chip fill, "Implementado" badge fill (paired with brand-700 text).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled "Em breve" / "Em manutenção" buttons and pills. Exempt from text-contrast minimums (WCAG inactive-control exception).

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Label of disabled "Em breve" / "Em manutenção" buttons and pills, on disabled-bg.

tokens.name: attention-600
tokens.usage: "Divergência" / pendência text and icon on surface and surface-page (5.9:1); never the only signal — always paired with the word "Divergência" or "Pendente".

tokens.name: attention-100
tokens.usage: Fill behind attention-600 badges and the highlighted diff column in Excel exports.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: "Não bate" / critical-mismatch text and icon on surface and surface-page (7.2:1); always paired with text, never color alone.

tokens.name: danger-100
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger-600 badges and the critical row highlight in Excel exports.

styles.name: title-app
styles.usage: The "Concilia" wordmark, next to the icon in the top bar.

styles.name: title-module
styles.usage: Screen titles: Movimentações, Relatórios, Conciliação de Vendas, Fechamento CP e DRE.

styles.name: title-section
styles.usage: Tab section headings inside a module (Arquivos, Mapeamento, Resultado).

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Module card titles, table headers, form field labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text, table cells, form values.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Module card description line, helper text, timestamps, the loader's status line.

styles.name: button-label
styles.usage: Text inside buttons, pills and the back link.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label (back button chevron, badge icon).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a card title and its description line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked form fields inside the Arquivos tab; gap between loader bars.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between a module card's text block and its Abrir button.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between stacked module cards on Home and Relatórios; gap between the icon and wordmark in the top bar.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margin around the screen content.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Text inputs, file-drop zones, table cells with a highlighted value.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small chrome: the module-tab content panel, the icon chip on a module card, the loader's bars.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Module cards, buttons and the loader's card — the dominant corner of the reformulated layout, replacing the old sharp/8px WinForms look.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the tab-step indicator, and the active-tab pill background.
